# Synthetic Evidence-Floor + Confirmation-Skew Deliverable

A minimal HARD-GATE-COMPLIANT deliverable that ALSO trips both Directive 03 advisory
warnings. It proves the warnings are non-blocking: the gate exits 0 and emits the honest
badge even though W1 (no primary evidence) and W2 (confirmation skew) both fire.

## 1. Recommendations

- Adopt the pattern, because the literature leans toward it (see §4).

## 2. Summary

The tired-dad version. All findings here rest on literature and practitioner reports; no
controlled experiment was run in-environment for these questions. (This §2 deliberately
does NOT carry the verbatim NO-PRIMARY-EVIDENCE banner, so W1 fires and tells the author
to add it.)

## 4. Analysis

The evidence skews toward agreement with the prevailing framework; the contrarian voices
were under-weighted. (This §4 deliberately omits the required contrarian-defense
subsection and the Phase 2 plan carries no disconfirming-search query, so W2 footnotes
both remediations as missing.)

## 6. Methodology

### Source Evaluation

Independent Phase 3.5 verification was run by a distinct verifier agent (`verify-ef-999`),
separate from the synthesis agent (`synth-ef-001`).

- Verification sample size: 3 sampled out of 3 total cards (100%).
- Failure count: 0.
- Failure-rate band: ≤5%.

**Real cut made this run:** one source was excluded (Excluded | 1).

**Bias-Guard Summary:**

| Bias-guard outcome | Count |
|--------------------|-------|
| Agreed with source — scored harder on dims 5, 6, 8 | 10 |
| Disagreed with source — scored more generously on dims 5, 6, 8 | 1 |
| Neutral / no strong reaction | 0 |
| **Total sources evaluated** | **11** |
